description: Source code for OpenThread platform diagnostics implementation for Zephyr RTOS, including diagnostic process handling, GPIO control, and radio transmission features.

methods.name: otPlatDiagProcess
methods.description: Processes diagnostic commands; currently reports unsupported feature.

methods.name: otPlatDiagModeGet
methods.description: Returns the current diagnostic mode state.

methods.name: otPlatDiagRadioReceived
methods.description: Stub for handling received radio frames.

methods.name: otPlatDiagRadioTransmitCarrier
methods.description: Transmits or stops transmitting a carrier signal if in diagnostic mode.

methods.name: otPlatDiagGpioSet
methods.description: Sets the state of a GPIO pin for diagnostics.

methods.name: otPlatDiagGpioGet
methods.description: Gets the current state of a GPIO pin for diagnostics.

methods.name: otPlatDiagGpioSetMode
methods.description: Configures the mode (input/output) of a GPIO pin.

methods.name: otPlatDiagGpioGetMode
methods.description: Gets the mode (input/output) of a GPIO pin.
